request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Instructions were missed.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "A rule may help."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work\" prescribes no concrete, observable behavior change and cannot be checked or enforced."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"This is pure platitude with no specific mechanism, condition, or example tying it to any identifiable failure mode."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"Not a skill, and even as a global claude-md rule it has no scoping condition beyond 'always' — it fails to target the specific circumstance under which instructions were missed."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"The remedy text is fully generic with no project-specific nouns, file names, or identifiers leaked from the evidence."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"Given the failure statement is too vague to diagnose a root cause, adding a permanent global claude-md instruction is not a justified or cheapest-adequate response — a no-op restating an already-implicit expectation."}}

actionability.justification: "Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work" prescribes no concrete, observable behavior change and cannot be checked or enforced.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: This is pure platitude with no specific mechanism, condition, or example tying it to any identifiable failure mode.

leakage.justification: The remedy text is fully generic with no project-specific nouns, file names, or identifiers leaked from the evidence.

routing_fitness.justification: Given the failure statement is too vague to diagnose a root cause, adding a permanent global claude-md instruction is not a justified or cheapest-adequate response — a no-op restating an already-implicit expectation.

trigger_quality.justification: Not a skill, and even as a global claude-md rule it has no scoping condition beyond 'always' — it fails to target the specific circumstance under which instructions were missed.
